subject: Liger micro-parity harness persisted at da18280
body: Lane B CPU prep is complete and persisted on Draft PR #82 at head da182800ee59c954e3b796308ca0b07529d53dc5. Added an isolated Qwen3.5 Liger micro-parity harness with scratch-path injection only: Qwen3.5 Gemma-style RMSNorm, SwiGLU, and masked fused-linear cross-entropy forward/backward comparisons under fixed BF16 thresholds. No import-time Liger dependency, no training-venv install, optimizer, weight mutation, or GPU execution. Expanded focused suite 33/33 PASS. Lane B remains GPU-idle until Lane A releases step32 + milestone evaluation.
